clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau once sat in a seminar in Boston, listening to a guy who made a million dollars a year back in the early '80s - serious money at the time.

The guy said if you liked what you heard, come to his five-day seminar in Los Angeles. Price: $10,000.

Kevin's first reaction: too far, too expensive, not happening.

Then the speaker looked at the room and said it plainly - some of you think it's too far, some of you think it's too much money, so you won't go, and that's why you're a loser.

That line changed Kevin's mind on the spot. Losers are always good at one thing: making excuses.

What excuse have you been hiding behind this week?
